entities.name: Samor
entities.description: Leader of the Sumifan songmages during the Brothers' War and Mishra's slave, historian and ambassador.

entities.name: Porros
entities.description: A prince of Sumifa who became a songmage, secretly betrayed them and destroyed Sumifa.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza, who held Samor as his slave.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Mishra's brother, whom Mishra wished to threaten.

entities.name: Claria
entities.description: Samor's daughter, whose name song and handprint locked the cockatrice's release.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Found Samor's skeleton and released and banished the Beast of the Hours.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: A rogue cockatrice that petrified Mishra's army and locals at Sarraza.

entities.name: Sumifan songmages
entities.description: Magic users of Sumifa led by Samor.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City buried by sand when Porros raised a sandstorm.

entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: Where the Beast of the Hours petrified Mishra's army.

entities.name: Fall of Sumifa
entities.description: The burying of Sumifa under sand by Porros.

events.summary: Samor finds young Porros tangled in a treetop and later accepts him into the songmages, naming him the Raptor.
events.quote: Samor gave Porros the title "the Raptor"

events.summary: Samor is summoned to Sarraza where the Beast of the Hours petrifies Mishra's army; a discordant note makes his spell one of imprisonment.
events.quote: Samor was summoned to Mishra at Sarraza

events.summary: Mishra threatens Samor into learning a song of unbinding to threaten Urza.
events.quote: Mishra then gave Samor three days to learn a song of unbinding

events.summary: Porros reveals himself as a traitor who summoned the cockatrice and sang the discordant tone.
events.quote: It was Porros himself who had summoned the cockatrice to begin with

events.summary: Samor locks the cockatrice's release into his daughter's name and handprint and transforms Porros into a raptor-like form.
events.quote: Samor secretly locked the music of the cockatrice's release into his daughter's name and handprint

events.summary: Porros slashes Samor's throat and buries Sumifa in a sandstorm.
events.quote: Porros slashed Samor's throat with a piece of broken mirror

events.summary: Three thousand years later Samor's skeleton is found and his song magic lets Ogwater Rifkin banish the Beast of the Hours.
events.quote: Samor's skeleton was found in the buried ruins of old Sumifa

relations.quote: Samor was a the leader of the Sumifan songmages during the Brothers' War
As his slave, he also worked as Mishra 's historian
Porros slashed Samor's throat with a piece of broken mirror
using his daughter Claria naming song as the melody
